intro: Montenegro is a parliamentary republic and a member of NATO.

chapters.title: Parliament and currency
text: The 81-member parliament chooses the government, and the president is directly elected. Montenegro uses the euro even though it is not in the EU or the eurozone; it adopted it on its own in 2002.

chapters.title: Montenegro in the world
text: Montenegro joined NATO in 2017 and is negotiating to join the EU.

keyTerms.meaning: EU countries that officially use the euro.
